newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S VIRO BUYS LOCK FIRM, PLANS LISTING.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S VIRO BUYS LOCK FIRM, PLANS LISTING.

text.p: South African firm Viro Security Group said on Friday it had bought L&S Locks for an undisclosed sum from Murray & Roberts' unit Abertech Industries.
The firm also added that it planned to eventually float itself on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.
Viro chief executive Rina King said the firm had been on the hunt for a major acquisition for some time to complement its Viro brands of locks. L&S makes Solid, Esco and Laudon locks.
"This move is strategic in that the two groups are complementary and introduces a range of locks that Viro does not at present manufacture," King said.
"An eventual listing on the JSE (is) also part of Viro Security Group's strategic plan," King said.
